story.body: You turned the leaves, refused them titles and numbers and names, and tied them. You put them at the bottom. You did not send them, and you did not say who they were for.

title: Read the first lines and tied the leaves

participation.context: Looked at the tied papers, and not at a face.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You saw the tied papers where you had laid them, at the bottom, with the coffer still open.

title: Saw the tape at the bottom

participation.context: Said the six words, and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.quote: Kept. Not given. That's a kind.

story.body: You named the act and not the person. The lid was down. The leaves stayed tied.

title: Shut the lid and called the leaves kept
